title: BLE GATT UUID to IPSO mapping registry
description:
Map standard BLE service/characteristic UUIDs to IPSO object/resource IDs.

**Scope:**
- Define data structure for UUID -> IPSO mapping (service UUID, char UUID) -> (object ID, resource ID, unit)
- Implement lookup function: given service_uuid + char_uuid, return IPSO mapping or None
- Populate registry with common BLE GATT services:
  - 0x181A Environmental Sensing -> IPSO 3303 (Temperature), 3304 (Humidity), 3315 (Barometer)
  - 0x180F Battery Service -> IPSO 3320 (Battery)
  - 0x181C User Data -> various IPSO mappings
  - 0x1810 Blood Pressure -> IPSO 3316
  - 0x1809 Health Thermometer -> IPSO 3303
- Support both 16-bit short UUIDs and 128-bit full UUIDs

**Reference:** spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md (Appendix K)

**Output:** python/src/lichen/ble/gatt_ipso_registry.py
